arxiv-1709-04970.title: Integrating Context of Statements within Description Logics
arxiv-1709-04970.creator: Antoine Zimmermann, José M. Giménez-García
arxiv-1709-04970.description: Abstract We address the problem of providing contextual information about a logical formula ( e.g. , provenance, date of validity, or confidence) and representing it within a logical system. In this case, it is needed to rely on a higher order or non standard formalism, or some kind of reification mechanism.

arxiv-1912-03722.title: Spatial and Temporal Management of Cellular HetNets with Multiple Solar Powered Drones A part of this work has been accepted for publication in IEEE Wireless Communications and Networking Conference (WCNC 2017) [ 1 ] . Ahmad Alsharoa is with the Engineering and Computer Computer Science Department,
arxiv-1912-03722.creator: Ahmad Alsharoa, Member, IEEE , Hakim Ghazzai, Member, IEEE , Abdullah Kadri, Senior Member, IEEE , and Ahmed E. Kamal, Fellow, IEEE
arxiv-1912-03722.description: Abstract This paper proposes an energy management framework for cellular heterogeneous networks (HetNets) supported by dynamic solar powered drones. A HetNet composed of a macrocell base station (BS), micro cell BSs, and drone small cell BSs are deployed to serve the networks’ subscribers.

arxiv-2111-13956.title: Understanding Anharmonic Effects on Hydrogen Desorption Characteristics of Mg n H 2n Nanoclusters by ab initio trained Deep Neural Network
arxiv-2111-13956.creator: Andrea Pedrielli, Paolo E. Trevisanutto, Lorenzo Monacelli, Giovanni Garberoglio, Nicola M. Pugno, Simone Taioli
arxiv-2111-13956.description: Abstract Magnesium hydride (MgH 2 ) has been widely studied for effective hydrogen storage. However, its bulk desorption temperature ( 553 553 K) is deemed too high for practical applications. Besides doping, a strategy to decrease such reaction energy for releasing hydrogen is the use of MgH 2 -based nanoparticles (NPs).

arxiv-2311-06251.title: AI for Investment: A Platform Disruption
arxiv-2311-06251.creator: Mohammad Rasouli, Ravi Chiruvolu, Ali Risheh
arxiv-2311-06251.description: Abstract With the investment landscape becoming more competitive, efficiently scaling deal sourcing and improving deal insights have become a dominant strategy for funds. While funds are already spending significant efforts on these two tasks, they cannot be scaled with traditional approaches; hence, there is a surge in automating them.

arxiv-2405-18793.title: Policy Zooming: Adaptive Discretization-based Infinite-Horizon Average-Reward Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2405-18793.creator: Avik Kar, Rahul Singh
arxiv-2405-18793.description: Abstract We study the infinite-horizon average-reward reinforcement learning (RL) for continuous space Lipschitz MDPs in which an agent can play policies from a given set Φ \Phi . The proposed algorithms efficiently explore the policy space by “zooming” into the “promising regions” of Φ \Phi , thereby achieving adaptivity gains in the performance.

arxiv-2503-00470.title: Rapid morphology characterization of two-dimensional TMDs and lateral heterostructures based on deep learning
arxiv-2503-00470.creator: Junqi He, Yujie Zhang, Jialu Wang, Tao Wang, Pan Zhang, Chengjie Cai, Jinxing Yang, Xiao Lin, Xiaohui Yang
arxiv-2503-00470.description: Abstract Two-dimensional (2D) materials and heterostructures exhibit unique physical properties, necessitating efficient and accurate characterization methods. Leveraging advancements in artificial intelligence, we introduce a deep learning-based method for efficiently characterizing heterostructures and 2D materials, specifically MoS 2 -MoSe 2 lateral heterostructures and MoS 2 flakes with varying shapes and thicknesses.

arxiv-2503-15285.title: PAPI-Reg: Patch-to-Pixel Solution for Efficient Cross-Modal Registration between LiDAR Point Cloud and Camera Image
arxiv-2503-15285.creator: Yuanchao Yue, Zhengxin Li, Wei Zhang, Huiyuan
arxiv-2503-15285.description: Abstract The primary requirement for cross-modal data fusion is the precise alignment of data from different sensors. However, the calibration between LiDAR point clouds and camera images is typically time-consuming and needs external calibration board or specific environmental features. Cross-modal registration effectively solves this problem by aligning the data directly without requiring external calibration.

arxiv-2503-21934.title: Proof or Bluff? Evaluating LLMs on 2025 USA Math Olympiad
arxiv-2503-21934.creator: Ivo Petrov, Jasper Dekoninck, Lyuben Baltadzhiev, Maria Drencheva, Kristian Minchev, Mislav Balunović, Nikola Jovanović, Martin Vechev
arxiv-2503-21934.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ivo Petrov, Jasper Dekoninck, Lyuben Baltadzhiev, Maria Drencheva, Kristian Minchev, Mislav Balunović, Nikola Jovanović, Martin Vechev. Recent math benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) such as MathArena indicate that state-of-the-art reasoning models achieve impressive performance on mathematical competitions like AIME, with the leading model, Gemini-2.5-Pro , achieving scores comparable to top human competitors. However, these benchmarks evaluate models solely based on final numerical answers, neglecting rigorous reasoning and proof generation which are essential for real-world mathematical tasks.

arxiv-2504-13882.title: Toward Automated Qualitative Analysis: Leveraging Large Language Models for Tutoring Dialogue Evaluation
arxiv-2504-13882.creator: Megan Gu, Chloe Qianhui Zhao, Claire Liu, Nikhil Patel, Jahnvi Shah, Jionghao Lin, Kenneth R. Koedinger
arxiv-2504-13882.description: Abstract Our study introduces an automated system leveraging large language models (LLMs) to assess the effectiveness of five key tutoring strategies: 1. giving effective praise , 2. reacting to errors , 3. determining what students know , 4. helping students manage inequity , and 5. responding to negative self-talk .

arxiv-2601-00181.title: Understanding Emotion in Discourse: Recognition Insights and Linguistic Patterns for Generation
arxiv-2601-00181.creator: Cheonkam Jeong, Adeline Nyamathi
arxiv-2601-00181.description: Abstract While Emotion Recognition in Conversation (ERC) has achieved high accuracy, two critical gaps remain: a limited understanding of which architectural choices actually matter, and a lack of linguistic analysis connecting recognition to generation. We address both gaps through a systematic analysis of the IEMOCAP dataset.

pmc-11325998.description: Background:The impact of different pretransplant dialysis modalities on post-transplant outcomes for pancreas-kidney transplantation is currently unclear. This study aims to assess the association between pretransplant dialysis modalities [hemodialysis (HD) and peritoneal dialysis] and outcomes following pancreas-kidney transplantation.Methods:The authors searched PubMed, EMBASE, and the Cochrane Library for relevant studies published from inception until 1 December 2023.

pmc-11340164.description: BackgroundMaxillary expansion is an important treatment method for maxillary transverse hypoplasia. pmc-11437141.title: Unraveling the role of the western North Pacific circulation anomaly in modulating Indian summer monsoon rainfall variability beyond ENSO
pmc-11437141.creator: Jun-Hyeok Son, Christian L. E. Franzke, Han-Kyoung Kim, Jae-Heung Park, Jung-Eun Chu
pmc-11437141.description: The Indian summer monsoon (ISM) rainfall interannual variability is known to be strongly linked to the El-Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO). This linear relationship is the primary factor in controlling the interannual variation in ISM precipitation. However, there are many outlier cases, and such deviations pose significant challenges in seasonal prediction over this region.

pmc-13079246.title: Fiber Track Length Gradients in the Avian Sound Localization Circuit Require Conduction Velocity Gradients to Maintain Isochronicity
pmc-13079246.creator: David M. Harris
pmc-13079246.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The chicken brainstem sound localization neural network exhibits a case where fiber length varies continuously across the fiber arrays connecting n. magnocellularis and n. Detailed morphometric measurements were taken to quantify these length gradients. For both ipsilateral and contralateral projections, the path lengths connecting the caudal low‐frequency segments are longer than those at the rostral high‐frequency end, with a linear path length gradient between them. The length and the length gradient of the contralateral projection increase from hatchling to 2–4 weeks.

pmc-13420499.title: Ginseng-derived exosomes loaded in fibrin gel promote retinal ganglion cell survival in glaucoma by exerting anti-inflammatory effects through modulating microglial polarization
pmc-13420499.creator: Dengming Zhou, Dehong Tan, Xuanqi Peng, Cailian Fang, Yongzhen Yu, Haroon Iqbal, Junfan Zhang, Lin Fu, Lewei Tang, Xiaoyu Zhou, Xinyue Zhang, Run Xiao, Wenxiang Zhu, Ludan Yue, Yuanbo Liang
pmc-13420499.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Glaucoma is the leading cause of irreversible blindness globally. Chronic neuroinflammation drives progressive retinal ganglion cell (RGC) loss independent of intraocular pressure, yet safe, sustained and precise neuroprotective modulation of the retinal inflammatory microenvironment remains a significant challenge. We developed an injectable fibrin gel delivery system loaded with ginseng-derived exosomes (GE-fibrin gel, GE-gel) to modulate microglial polarization, reduce retinal inflammation and promote RGC survival.
